run_profile_extraction: run the profile_extraction function to benchmark feature extraction timing metrics for videos
run_schedule_profile_extraction: run the schedule_profile_extraction entry point via hydra to profile feature extraction locally or on SLURM
profile_feature_extraction_timing: profile feature extraction forward pass, data loading, and device transfer times across batch sizes
benchmark_extract_features: benchmark the extract_features function with different batch sizes, num_workers, and prefetch_factor configurations
schedule_slurm_job: schedule the profile_extraction function as a SLURM job using create_executor when run_locally is false
